hypothesis: Frozen phase confirmed (updates <= 0.007); prediction from 3,200 holds (acceleration L1 interchange 0.286 < 0.35). The OOD_DEV jitter is shrinking with the learning rate (|change| 0.003-0.015 over 3,000-3,300 vs up to 0.08 before), supporting the noise interpretation.
evidence: Routine Level-1 audit (OBS interchange, persistent pooled edit, geometry, weight lineage); all deltas inside the stationary bands (acc 0.01, OOD_DEV 0.08 (~2 sd of the converged noise), IIA 0.02, editability 0.04, interaction 0.03, acceleration L1 0.05).
key_question: Will OOD_DEV variance keep shrinking as the learning rate decays?
best_experiment: Continue routine recording; scheduled Level-2 checks at 4,000 and 5,000 (OOD locus, head anatomy).
intervention_rationale: Stationary network; editability already high; registered primitives shown (1,500 / 1,800 dry runs) to cost held-out accuracy.
